features: Explosion-proof: cFMus Class I/II/III Division 1 Groups B, C, D, E, F, G; IECEx/ATEX II 2 G Ex db IIB+H2, II 2 D Ex tb IIIC
Powder-coated aluminum housing (RAL2000) made in USA, NEMA Type 4X
150 dB WDR, SSDR, SSNR V, DIS with built-in gyro, defog, LDC
Analytics: tampering, loitering, directional, defocus, fog, virtual line, enter/exit, (dis)appear, audio, face, motion detection, digital auto tracking, sound classification
RS-485, alarm in 1 / out 1, audio in (mic/line) + line out, bi-directional audio
ONVIF Profile S/G, SUNAPI, Wisenet Open Platform
release_notes: Specs per official Hanwha Vision specification sheet (Specifications_TNO-X6072EPT1-Z_260101_EN.pdf). Operating temperature: -40 to +60C (USA) / -50 to +60C (Canada); a second row lists -10 to +55C (PoE only). WDR is 150 dB in the spec table (key features say 120 dB). Key features say 2 x 256GB SD; spec table says 2 slots up to 512GB. Dimensions converted from inches.

frigate.notes: Hanwha profiles: profile1=MJPEG, profile2=main, profile3=sub (default Wisenet profile layout); not yet verified on this model.
